title: Meeting time
prompt:
Planning call: November 18, 2026 at 14:30 UTC, 25 minutes. Extract date (ISO),time (HH:MM),timezone,duration_minutes. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: date, time, timezone, duration_minutes. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
